description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Order made under Section 02 of the Special Commodity Levy Act No. 48 of 2007 and Published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2160/63 of 01.02.2020 in hes respect of B'onions (HS Code 0708-10-20) is rescinded with effect From 1st May, 2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that modifies existing regulations (rescinding a previous order and imposing new levy rates), which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, this is in his capacity as the authority issuing the legal order, not as the primary focus of the content. The core substance is regulatory - modifying levy rates and rescinding previous orders - making Type 5 the appropriate classification.
